title: Adjuster workbench redesign: inbox and claim first view
story: As an adjuster I want a dense, scannable inbox and a first view that tells me the claim story at a glance so that I can act on the right claims first
acceptance: Uses fx-app-shell, the design system and <fx-demo-bar>; old dev form gone when the bar is present

Inbox: KPI tiles (open, due today, overdue, fast-tracked), a table with claim number, insured, line, severity chip, status chip, regulatory timer countdown (colour by urgency), assigned date; filters (mine/all, status, severity) and sorting; good empty state

Claim first view: header with claim number, status, severity, line, loss date and location; AI summary card that always shows provider, model, confidence and explanation (standards: never AI output without them); next best actions as actionable rows; regulatory timers; parties, vehicles and coverage cards; documents; audit timeline; the subrogation flag visible when present
tests/ui/adjuster.test.mjs and tests/unit/web/adjuster/ updated and passing; full npm test no new failures
Screenshots: docs/design/screens/adjuster-inbox and -claim at 1440x900 with the demo adjuster persona (inbox not empty); reviewer opens them
brief: Compare with docs/design/before/adjuster*.png. Do not edit src/web/shared/.

verdicts.reason: Own 35 tests pass and criteria met, but full npm test has a NEW regression: tests/ui/demo-bar.test.mjs 'switching claimant to adjuster lands signed in on the adjuster inbox' now times out on '#inbox-body tr[data-claim-id]' (data-claim-id moved to the anchor, not the row); also csr.test.mjs adjuster-view test waits on removed #dev-form. Keep a tr[data-claim-id] hook in the inbox rows and coordinate the demo-bar/csr test selectors; other csr failures (190-192,194,195) and recent.test.mjs innerHTML check look like CSR-ticket work in flight.
All criteria met; adjuster/demo-bar/csr tests 48 pass; full npm test 1528 pass, 0 fail (3 baseline todos); screenshots show populated inbox and claim view
